findings.detail: X02 incorrectly requires a rate for source rows explicitly marked N/A(6) with no principal, while the adjacent funded tranche carries the stated coupon.

rationale: Raw SOI evidence shows the flagged blank is faithful to the filing: the representative ABC Legal component is explicitly N/A(6) in the Interest Rate column and has no principal, while the adjacent funded ABC Legal tranche states 7.92%. The same N/A(6), no-principal pattern recurs broadly across the flagged population. Therefore the data is not missing a disclosed rate; X02 is mis-scoped to non-rate-bearing components.
